action.description: Structured operation. For collections, call collection.list, then collection.describe, then collection.query. Use a returned note address with show to read its body. Prefer this over the legacy command field.

notebook.description: Notebook name or id; defaults to the current notebook where supported.

address.description: Notebook-relative note address (<notebook-id>::<path>) or an absolute note path. Use this with show, edit, write, or delete.

tag.description: Optional tag path filter. Matches the path itself and all sub-tags; a leading # is accepted (for example 项目/Flowix).

content.description: Complete Markdown, replacement body, or artifact source.

old.description: Exact text that must occur once for edit.

collectionId.description: Stable collection identity. Provide this or path for collection.read, collection.describe, and collection.query.

path.description: Notebook-relative collection file path. Provide this or collectionId for collection.read, collection.describe, and collection.query.

domain.description: Collection data domain. Required when querying a hybrid collection.

viewId.description: Optional saved view to apply while querying a collection.

fields.description: Field IDs to return for collection.query. Omit to return all fields.

snapshot.description: Snapshot returned by the first page. Reuse it on later pages; a changed data set returns DATA_CHANGED.

command.description: Legacy restricted CLI command without the flowix prefix.
